selection_basis: rank 4 residual-blind GHASP-SPARC source federation; ranks 1-2 already tested and rank 3 conventionally disturbed
common_radius_policy: SPARC radii within the overlap of both positive GHASP side curves; sidewise linear interpolation without extrapolation
primary_statistics: weighted compatibility of q_approaching and q_receding on common radii
uncertainty_policy: propagate GHASP velocity errors through the inverse map; SPARC baryonic-model covariance remains an explicit missing nuisance
claim_boundary: retrospective law-compatibility preflight only; common q is degenerate with dark halo/shared dynamics and morphology body is not source-ready
